playstyles.overview: Jean is a versatile support who takes little field time to use her abilities. She provides healing, grouping, respectable personal damage, and various buffs through the artifact sets she can hold.
Sunfire abuses the Pyro self-application from Bennett’s Burst, which is Swirled by the Anemo self-application from Jean’s Burst. As a result, this pairing is very good at applying Pyro onto enemies.

playstyles.overview: This is Pyro Traveler’s usual role. They use their Skill and Burst to gain Nightsoul points and apply Pyro from off-field, thus enabling reactions for their teammates.
With their Tap Skill that hits once every second, Pyro Traveler can deal decent AoE damage through Burgeon.
At C6, Pyro Traveler can stay on-field to deal Pyro-converted attacks. This playstyle requires heavy investment into Pyro Traveler and their supports to make it viable.
